title: Hardware or software?
instruction: Sort them: what can you touch (hardware), and what just runs on the device (software)?

items.why: A chip that carries out the instructions of programs.
A game is a program. You install it and delete it again.
A physical screen you can touch.
An operating system is a program that runs the whole phone.
An app is a program, even if you always have it to hand.
A physical input device. A keyboard on the screen, though, is software.
A program you open websites with.
A component that turns an electrical signal into sound.
A computer's operating system, so a program.
A physical sensor that captures light.
An app is a program. A calculator with buttons would be hardware.

debrief: You can touch hardware. Software is the programs that run on the hardware. A phone needs both: without programs it is just a piece of glass and metal.
